description: Exact sidewise max fusion of zero-forcing and orientation inertia inside block support, coupled to nonbipartite support on one Z0.

quantifiers.Z0: some one eligible Z0 passes both fused bipartite and nonbipartite joint-support systems
quantifiers.component: every bipartite component passes a fused generic orientation or the exact lightlike alternative
quantifiers.same_spans: for each generic orientation, ZF and inertia lower-bound the same U_A and U_B, so each side uses their maximum
quantifiers.seed: one impossible required K6 seed rejects a graph

semantics.allowed_defects: upper bounds; allowed coordinates may be zero
